findings: ThumbnailPrewarmer does await scanPathsAndWait and subsequent thumbnail load calls. However scan=false, no refreshed items, and per-item thumbnail errors only log and return Unit. ProactiveIndexingWorker can therefore report Result.success even when prewarm failed, narrowing prior v10 completion uncertainty.

Prewarmer discards returned thumbnail Bitmap objects without explicit recycle or retained ownership; temporary memory relies on runtime collection. No measured leak or Android allocation profile claimed.

CoilPreloader enqueues every item with no explicit target, size, priority or cancellation handle retained. Source low-priority/thumbnail comments are not configured request guarantees; ImageLoader defaults remain unread.

HiddenFileFilter scan exclusion rejects any path component starting dot or underscore. UI helper combines this with final-name hyphen prefix, but filterHiddenFiles applies only final hyphen rule. These policies differ and can include/exclude different sets; callers remain to inspect.

FolderDetails describes unprocessed counts and adds isPrimarySystemFolder, while persistent FolderDetailsCache lacks that field. Mapping may recompute it; actual repository implementation remains unread.
